import zipfile, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    print("Files in archive:")
    for n in z.namelist():
        print(" ", n)

    # shared strings
    shared = []
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall('m:si', ns):
            text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
            shared.append(text)

    # sheet names
    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    sheets = [(s.get('name'), s.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id'))
              for s in wb.find('m:sheets', ns)]
    print("\nSheets:", sheets)

    # worksheet rels
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    relmap = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels}

    for name, rid in sheets:
        target = relmap[rid]
        if not target.startswith('xl/'):
            target = 'xl/' + target
        print(f"\n===== Sheet: {name} ({target}) =====")
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        for row in root.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
            vals = []
            for c in row:
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find('m:v', ns)
                if v is None:
                    vals.append((ref, ''))
                    continue
                val = v.text
                if t == 's':
                    val = shared[int(val)]
                elif t == 'b':
                    val = 'TRUE' if val == '1' else 'FALSE'
                vals.append((ref, val))
            print(vals)
EOF

import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

MAIN = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    print("Files in archive:")
    for n in z.namelist():
        print(" ", n)

    shared = []
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall('{%s}si' % MAIN):
            text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{%s}t' % MAIN))
            shared.append(text)

    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    sheets = [(s.get('name'), s.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id'))
              for s in wb.find('{%s}sheets' % MAIN)]
    print("\nSheets:", sheets)

    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    relmap = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels}

    for name, rid in sheets:
        target = relmap[rid]
        if not target.startswith('xl/'):
            target = 'xl/' + target
        print("\n===== Sheet: %s (%s) =====" % (name, target))
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        for row in root.iter('{%s}row' % MAIN):
            vals = []
            for c in row:
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find('{%s}v' % MAIN)
                if v is None:
                    vals.append((ref, ''))
                    continue
                val = v.text
                if t == 's':
                    val = shared[int(val)]
                elif t == 'b':
                    val = 'TRUE' if val == '1' else 'FALSE'
                vals.append((ref, val))
            print(vals)

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
print(z.namelist())
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
for row in root.iter(NS + 'row'):
    cells = []
    for c in row:
        ref = c.get('r')
        v = c.find(NS + 'v')
        val = v.text if v is not None else ''
        if c.get('t') == 'inlineStr':
            is_el = c.find(NS + 'is')
            val = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in is_el.iter(NS + 't'))
        cells.append((ref, val))
    print(cells)
